描述_EN: in the 18th century the house was the home of the cotton family. it was the property of the king family of madingley hall, near cambridge, before the v&a acquired it. this silk bedspread is formed by three lengths of fabric, each the width of the loom. at least one family member, admiral sir charles cotton, visited east asia in 1770-1772.
描述_ZN: 在18世纪，这个房子是棉花家族的家。 在V&A收购它之前，它是剑桥附近Madingley Hall的King家族的财产。 这个丝绸床罩是由三段布料组成的，每段都是织机的宽度。 至少有一位家庭成员，海军上将查尔斯-科姆，在1770-1772年访问了东亚。
